Task: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure Prometheus node_exporter
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    node_exporter_version: "1.8.2"
    node_exporter_user: node_exporter
    node_exporter_group: node_exporter
    node_exporter_bin_dir: /usr/local/bin
    node_exporter_listen_address: "0.0.0.0:9100"
    node_exporter_arch_map:
      x86_64: amd64
      aarch64: arm64
      armv7l: armv7
    node_exporter_arch: "{{ node_exporter_arch_map[ansible_architecture] | default('amd64') }}"
    node_exporter_download_url: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ node_exporter_arch }}.tar.gz"
    node_exporter_checksums:
      amd64: "6809dd0b3ec45fd6e992c19071d6b5253aed3ead7bf0686885a51d85c6643c66"
      arm64: "627382b9723c642411c33f30c2353e3c7a26a34d29df02173d96d420d2003636"
      armv7: "b54e22de24cf41be8e8b71b2eb74ec0d99c30635e8a9eb8e7a3f3ff62d1cb1e0"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure required packages are present
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name:
          - tar
          - gzip
        state: present

  tasks:
    - name: Create node_exporter system group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: true
        state: present

    - name: Create node_exporter system user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        home: /var/lib/node_exporter
        create_home: false
        state: present

    - name: Check if node_exporter binary exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_bin_dir }}/node_exporter"
      register: node_exporter_binary

    - name: Get installed node_exporter version
      ansible.builtin.command: "{{ node_exporter_bin_dir }}/node_exporter --version"
      register: node_exporter_installed_version
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      when: node_exporter_binary.stat.exists

    - name: Set installation required flag
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        node_exporter_install_required: "{{ not node_exporter_binary.stat.exists or node_exporter_version not in (node_exporter_installed_version.stdout | default('')) }}"

    - name: Create temporary download directory
      ansible.builtin.tempfile:
        state: directory
        suffix: node_exporter
      register: node_exporter_tmp
      when: node_exporter_install_required

    - name: Download node_exporter archive
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ node_exporter_download_url }}"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_tmp.path }}/node_exporter.tar.gz"
        checksum: "sha256:{{ node_exporter_checksums[node_exporter_arch] }}"
        mode: "0644"
        timeout: 60
      when: node_exporter_install_required

    - name: Extract node_exporter archive
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "{{ node_exporter_tmp.path }}/node_exporter.tar.gz"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_tmp.path }}"
        remote_src: true
      when: node_exporter_install_required

    - name: Install node_exporter binary
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ node_exporter_tmp.path }}/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ node_exporter_arch }}/node_exporter"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_bin_dir }}/node_exporter"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"
        remote_src: true
      when: node_exporter_install_required
      notify: Restart node_exporter

    - name: Clean up temporary download directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_tmp.path }}"
        state: absent
      when: node_exporter_install_required and node_exporter_tmp.path is defined

    - name: Deploy node_exporter systemd unit
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Prometheus Node Exporter
          Documentation=https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter
          Wants=network-online.target
          After=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ node_exporter_user }}
          Group={{ node_exporter_group }}
          ExecStart={{ node_exporter_bin_dir }}/node_exporter \
            --web.listen-address={{ node_exporter_listen_address }}
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5s

          NoNewPrivileges=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          PrivateDevices=true
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          RestrictSUIDSGID=true
          RestrictRealtime=true
          RestrictNamespaces=true
          LockPersonality=true
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
          SystemCallArchitectures=native
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          AmbientCapabilities=
          ReadWritePaths=

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
